items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Kelly was the leader and we had chorus girls... I think I was in Kelly Martin's Band... Kelly Martin found out I was in town and then he hired me

ctx.x: Well, Kelly Martin in Detroit at the Club Congo. I'll tell you what I did. We went there one time...my father took me to Detroit and we went to the theater and we saw Andy Kirk and that's when I first heard Bird and Jimmy Forrest was in the band and Andy Kirk...he's in the union now, he's an official in the union, but he was so...I eventually ended up playing with him, a few jobs...and my father says to me, "My God, Charlie Parker, he sounds like a machine." Haha. Dig? I mean...that's another aspect of sound.…
Well, now, your father got some ears then?

items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: I worked at Tom's Cabin with him and then I worked at Cozy Corner with him

ctx.x: details about the period of time when you entered the "big time" with Kelly Martin and what you were doing just before that and how that job came about.

Well, what had happened, my father--like I said before--we went to Detroit to visit and we saw Andy Kirk and I first heard Charlie Parker and Jimmy Forrest. But my father, unbeknownst to me, he knew about the Club Congo and I think they were rehearsing that day and we went by there and he got Kelly Martin to the side... and Kelly Martin didn't tell me this till years later. He says, "My son is good, please hire my son, if you want him to play tenor or baritone, I'll get him a baritone." And I didn't know that…
side and said, "Please hire my son." He told me that years later. I say, "Well, I'll be dawgone;" he says, "Yeah, your father told me." Hahahaha.
